observation.depicts: Mustard-yellow web page 'How Secure Is My Password?' with '(:pjackim.1234' in a white input bar and 'It would take a computer about 53 million years'.
observation.text_readable: 'How Secure Is My Password?'; '#1 Password Strength Tool. Trusted and used by millions.'; '(:pjackim.1234'; '53 million years'. The small 'It would take a computer about' and 'to crack your password' lines are readable but faint.
observation.composition: Heading at top, white input bar in the upper-middle, large '53 million years' centred in the lower half; balanced margins; the last line sits close to the bottom edge.
observation.tone_and_contrast: White text on mustard yellow, moderate contrast; the white input bar with black text stands out strongly; small light text on yellow is lower contrast.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Clean, crisp text; mild compression softness. No cursor or watermark; a cyan marker at the input's left edge.
observation.scan_first_read: A page asking how secure a password is, answering '53 million years'.
